beats.say: A page in the bin and a document left on the desk are ready-made information for an attacker.
Tearing a page by hand is not enough. Putting the pieces back together is easy.
Confidential paper goes to the shredder, and old flash drives and laptops go to technical support.
When you leave your desk, lock the screen and put documents in a locked cabinet.

scenes.title: Before you leave your desk
scenes.intro: You leave your desk several times a day. Look at the windows that open and decide.

steps.label: You are off to a 15 minute meeting

body.text: Your computer will be unattended for 15 minutes. Lock it now?

actions.label: Lock
actions.feedback: Correct. On an unlocked screen anyone can write from your mailbox or take files.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: A few minutes are enough. Lock the screen every time you stand up.

steps.label: You want to throw away an old flash drive

body.text: Quick format: file space will be marked as free.

steps.say: The drive holds old staff lists.

actions.label: Eject and give to technical support
actions.feedback: Correct. Technical support wipes the drive fully or destroys it.

actions.label: Quick format and bin it
actions.feedback: A quick format does not erase files, it only hides them. Ordinary software can recover them.

body.text: Hi, can I give my old work laptop to a relative? I deleted the files and emptied the recycle bin.

actions.label: Reply: No, hand it to technical support
actions.feedback: Correct. A work device belongs to the organisation, and technical support cleans the disk.

actions.label: Reply: Fine, the files are deleted
actions.feedback: Emptying the recycle bin does not clean the disk. Deleted files can be recovered with special software.

body.text: 3 documents are queued in your name. If not collected, they will be deleted at 18:00.

actions.label: Go to the printer and collect
actions.feedback: Correct. Collect what you need, and let the queue delete what you do not.

actions.label: Send them all to print directly
actions.feedback: Direct printing drops pages in the tray without waiting for you. Secure print exists for exactly this.

scenes.prompt: Match each item with the right way to dispose of it.
scenes.explain: Confidential paper never goes in the ordinary bin. Devices are wiped and destroyed only by technical support.

nodes.text: You step out for tea. A contract folder is on the desk and a sticky note with a password is on the monitor.

choices.label: I lock the folder in the cabinet and take the note
choices.feedback: Correct. Ten minutes is plenty of time to take a photo.

choices.label: I will be quick, leave it
choices.feedback: A visitor, courier or repair worker may come in. Put the document away, and never keep a password on a sticky note.

nodes.text: I have a meeting with your manager. May I look at the document in this folder?
nodes.speaker: Visitor (at your desk)
nodes.spoken: I have a meeting with your manager. <breath> May I look at the document in this folder?

choices.label: I politely refuse and call my manager
choices.feedback: Excellent. Only someone authorised sees the document.

choices.label: I show it, he is the manager's guest
choices.feedback: His identity and rights have not been checked. Confirm with your manager first.

question.prompt: Which method destroys confidential paper most reliably?

options.label: A shredder that cuts into small particles
options.feedback: Correct. Putting tiny particles back together is practically impossible.

options.label: A shredder that cuts long strips
options.feedback: Strips can be lined up to rebuild the page. Choose a shredder that cuts small pieces.

options.label: Tearing it into four by hand
options.feedback: Taping four pieces together takes a minute. Confidential paper goes to the shredder.

options.label: Into the ordinary bin, face down
options.feedback: Rubbish leaves the building, and out there anyone can open it.

scenes.explain: For confidential paper, use a shredder that cuts small particles or a confidential waste box.

points: Confidential paper goes to the shredder, and devices go to technical support.
Deleting and quick formatting do not erase data.
When you leave your desk, lock the screen and put documents away.
